keyEvents.text: Goal! Utrecht 0, NEC 1. Kevin Kers (NEC) header from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Mitchel Bakker with a cross.
Goal! Utrecht 0, NEC 2. Dusan Tadic (NEC) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Deveron Fonville.
Goal! Utrecht 1, NEC 2. Yoann Cathline (Utrecht) right footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Ángel Alarcón following a fast break.
Goal! Utrecht 1, NEC 3. Dusan Tadic (NEC) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the high centre of the goal.
Substitution, Utrecht. Nordin Amrabat replaces Marius Broholm.
Substitution, Utrecht. Oualid Agougil replaces Artem Stepanov.
Substitution, Utrecht. Adrian Blake replaces Ángel Alarcón.
Goal! Utrecht 2, NEC 3. Dani de Wit (Utrecht) header from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Nordin Amrabat with a cross.
Substitution, NEC. Clement Bischoff replaces Kevin Kers.
Nordin Amrabat (Utrecht) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Utrecht. Sem van Duijn replaces Per Kloosterboer.
Substitution, NEC. Philippe Sandler replaces Deveron Fonville because of an injury.
Bryan Linssen (NEC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, NEC. Tobias Storm replaces Gabriel Brás.
Substitution, NEC. Jamiro Monteiro replaces Tjaronn Chery.
Substitution, NEC. Willum Willumsson replaces Dusan Tadic.
Clement Bischoff (NEC) is shown the yellow card.
Yoann Cathline (Utrecht) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Utrecht. Jakov Medic replaces Niklas Vesterlund.
Willum Willumsson (NEC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match (NEC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
